description: A yellow mancala board with small blue and green glass marbles sits on a red bedspread in front of a white pillow. The right hand reaches in from the right, pinches up a marble from the far-right cup, carries it leftward over the board, and drops it into a cup on the left side, then hovers above the next cup as if continuing the move; the right-hand object is the single marble while it’s held, and otherwise the hand is not touching anything.
